ValidationRule.description: Block user from updating the College Stage & College Status until Gportal field is marked TRUE and Deposit Deadline Date has a date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Id <> '00ed00000017Iob', $User.API_User__c <> TRUE, RecordType.Name = "Graduate Application", College__r.Name = "W. P. Carey School of Business", ISPICKVAL(College_Stage__c, "Admitted"), OR (ISPICKVAL(College_Status__c, "Admit with Deficiencies"), ISPICKVAL(College_Status__c, "Admit")), OR (Is_Gportal_Complete__c = FALSE, ISBLANK( WPC_Deposit_Deadline__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the college stage or college status until 'Is Gportal Complete?' = TRUE and a date is populated in the Deposit Deadline Date.
